results.title: FedECA: federated external control arms for causal ...
results.content: In this work, we present FedECA, a federated external control arm method, which is a federated version of the well-known inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) statistical method27.") for time-to-event outcomes. We show that FedECA achieves identical conclusions to IPTW on pooled data as well as better statistical power compared to a competing method based on federated analytics (FA), while also controlling for moment differences between the two arms. To compare the two methods, we consider scenarios with different levels of covariate shift, which is a parameter that controls the intensity of the confounding factors on the treatment allocation variable, biasing the two groups (see “Synthetic data generating model of time-to-event outcome” for more details on the data generation). Jean Ogier du Terrail, Quentin Klopfenstein, Honghao Li, Imke Mayer, Nicolas Loiseau, Mohammad Hallal, Michael Debouver, Thibault Camalon, Thibault Fouqueray, Jorge Arellano Castro, Zahia Yanes, Félix Balazard & Mathieu Andreux *et al.* FedECA: federated external control arms for causal inference with time-to-event data in distributed settings.
